title: Chapter 157 - 157 I Can'T Control My Feelings; Invite The Mentor To Eat Together!
content:
Chapter 157 - 157 I Can'T Control My Feelings; Invite The Mentor To Eat Together!

Chapter 157 - 157 I Can't Control My Feelings; Invite the Mentor to Eat Together!

157 I Can’t Control My Feelings; Invite the Mentor to Eat Together!

Then, Lin Fan, Qin Yuxuan, Senior Fan, and Senior Lu returned to the 78th floor.

Lin Fan held Qin Yuxuan’s hand and walked slowly to the huge, transparent window. He looked down into the distance.

“Yuxuan, this office is for you to start your company. Do you like it?” he asked with a smile.

Two streams of hot tears rolled down from Qin Yuxuan’s beautiful eyes.

“Yuxuan, why are you crying?” Lin Fan was stunned.

“Oh…”

Qin Yuxuan did not explain at all. She directly pressed her fiery lips against his.

At this moment, silence was better than sound!

This kiss was her answer!

She was completely enveloped in happiness and happiness!

With such a boyfriend, what could she ask for?

Qin Yuxuan had even forgotten that Senior Fan and Senior Lu were still in the empty office.

She really could not control her emotions!

Of course, Senior Fan and Senior Lu did not notice their actions.

That was because they were still in a daze.

This spacious and luxurious office overlooking the entire Modu would be his workplace in the future?

They were still in disbelief.

After a long while, Qin Yuxuan parted with Lin Fan, her face flushed red.

Lin Fan wiped the lipstick off the corner of his mouth and asked, “The company’s location has been settled. You probably haven’t prepared the start-up funds yet, nor have you attracted any investment clients, right?”

Speaking of work, Qin Yuxuan immediately came out of her shy state. It was as if she had transformed into a professional white-collar worker and was full of energy.

“We’re preparing to borrow 500,000 yuan each from the university, totaling 1.5 million yuan.”

“As for the clients, we have some potential clients from the past. After the company opens, we’ll have in-depth contact and cooperation.

“In addition, my mentor is willing to help introduce some customers to me…”

When Lin Fan heard that, he nodded his head thoughtfully and said, “How about this? I’ll take out 200 million first. Part of it will be the start-up capital, and the other part will be given to the company by me as your first customer. You guys can determine how to invest it.”

Silence.

The entire empty office was silent.

Senior Lu and Senior Fan opened their mouths wide, forming an O shape.

What did they hear?

He would take out 200 million first?

His tone was so calm.

It was as if he was taking out 200 yuan!

Did he have to be so domineering?

200 million yuan! He could become a key client of any large investment company and obtain a guaranteed high return on investment.

At this moment, he directly took it out for a newly established…In fact, it was a small company that could close down at any time.

Once it went bankrupt, the 200 million yuan would go down the drain!

Taking out 200 million for his girlfriend to practice?

It turned out that there was such selfless love in the world!

“Lin Fan…”

Qin Yuxuan’s beautiful eyes, which had just regained their calm, became misty again.

Then, she ignored Senior Lu and Senior Fan and jumped into Lin Fan’s arms.

After a long time, they separated again.

Lin Fan said, “It’s getting late. Why don’t we go eat first?”

“Alright,” Qin Yuxuan replied softly.

“I want to call my mentor over too. She’s helped me a lot…”

Lin Fan could not help but think of that short-haired female professor who kept asking him to come back and continue to derive the formula.

“Of course.”

At this moment, Senior Lu said, “I finally understand why Lin Fan was able to woo Yu Xuan. Not even a celestial immortal can withstand such an attack!”

“Celestial Immortal?” Lin Fan asked. “That can’t compare to my Yuxuan.” As he spoke, he gently stroked Qin Yuxuan’s hair.

Senior Lu said, “This wave of PDA… I feel like I don’t even need to eat anymore.”

Then, she asked, “Oh right, Lin Fan, do you have a brother?”

“I have a younger sister,” Lin Fan said.

Senior Lu heaved a long sigh, looking as if she had missed out on hundreds of millions of yuan.

The few of them chatted as they walked. Not long after, they arrived at Li Restaurant.

The outside of the Li Restaurant was rather ordinary.

The interior of the restaurant was decorated in black, giving off a sense of grandeur and luxury.

“When I first came to Modu to study, I read a lot of legends about Li Restaurant’s dishes on the internet…” Senior Lu said excitedly.

“I heard that the founder of Li Restaurant used to be a second-grade official!”

“Moreover, he was the kind of high-ranking official who specialized in tasting imperial banquets!”

“The dishes of Li Restaurant were made according to the imperial banquet after he retired!”

“In other words, the dishes here are all things that the emperor used to eat!”

“I don’t know how many times I’ve passed by this shop, but I’ve never walked in even once… My wallet really doesn’t allow it.”

“Today, thanks to Lin Fan and Yuxuan, I finally have a chance! I have to try it!”

The more Senior Lu spoke, the more excited she became.

Although the dishes had not been served yet, she seemed to have smelled the fragrance and could not help but swallow her saliva.

“The owner of Li Restaurant didn’t retire,” Senior Fan corrected. “The Qing dynasty perished. However, this shop is indeed very famous. Both Elder Jin and Cheng Long have come here to dine.”

“Yeah.” Senior Sister Lu praised, “The food must be delicious!”

At this moment, a series of low footsteps sounded from outside.

Then, the female professor with short hair strolled in.

Senior Fan and Qin Yuxuan, as well as Senior Lu, all stood up and said respectfully, “Hello, Professor Feng!”

Professor Feng nodded and was about to speak…

In the next moment, her small eyes suddenly widened.

Then, she took big strides and quickly walked in front of Lin Fan. She hugged his arm and shouted excitedly, “I finally found you. I won’t let you go again!”

It was as if Lin Fan had stolen her wallet and she was afraid that he would run away.
